My friend Ben is very kind. David's favorite season is winter. We talk about history a lot. This week is very busy.
David wants to visit Chengdu. Ben likes soup too. The office is not far from my home. Best of all, can you hold my bag for a second?
I like my life very much. Ben often helps me with history. I am happy every day.
